events.title: Next Fest demo update, full game on 10 November
events.summary: The demo just got its biggest update for Steam Next Fest. If you played it in the summer, a lot has changed. New here? Smash containers, grab the gold and find the keys before the clock runs out. What's new The Watch and The Stash Every few heists the Captain of the Watch knocks for his dues: nine per city, each bigger than the last. Pay early and it costs less. events.title: Town Rebuilt, Guided First Heist, and a New Mimic Encounter
events.summary: Town Rebuilt, Guided First Heist, and a New Mimic Encounter Hi everyone, The biggest update to the Thieves & Gold demo is now live. The Town has been rebuilt, the opening heist is now guided by the characters themselves, a new Mimic encounter has been added, and the complete demo is now available in German. This update also includes major improvements to bombs, hammer targeting, challenges, run results, the Skill Tree, room fairness, and overall readability. Town and Crew Rebuilt Town interface

events.title: macOS version + retroactive Relic points
events.summary: Demo update - now playable on macOS! Relic card points are now granted retroactively when unlocked, plus a sweep of performance improvements. Have fun, thieves!

events.title: Thieves and Gold - Demo Available Now!
events.summary: In this early demo you can:- Play through four handcrafted rooms- Chase more Skill Tree unlocks as you keep playing- Get a feel for the loot flow, timer pressure, and progression- Help shape the game with your feedbackThis is still an early build, so you may run into rough edges, bugs, and balance that will keep evolving. events.title: Thieves and Gold Steam Page Is Now Live
events.summary: After many months of work, the Steam page for Thieves and Gold is now live.Thieves and Gold is a medieval loot-heist incremental where you smash containers, grab gold, uncover hidden keys, and recruit a crew of thieves to grow stronger between runs.Race the clock in Heist Mode or play more relaxed in Casual Mode while upgrading your tools, building your crew, and pushing your luck for bigger scores.I’m excited to finally share the game with you, and this is just the beginning.
